question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Opulence
solution: The correct answer is "**Prosperity **". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given **word:** • **Opulence**: great wealth or luxuriousness. (महान धन या विलासिता ) • **Example**: *Her mansion was a sight of sheer **opulence**.* • Let's look at the **meaning** of the given **options:** • **View**: the ability to see something or to be seen from a particular place. (किसी चीज़ को देखने या किसी विशेष स्थान से देखे जाने की क्षमता।) • **Sagacity**: the quality of having or showing understanding and the ability to make good judgments. (समझ रखने या दिखाने की गुणवत्ता और अच्छे निर्णय लेने की क्षमता।) • **Recognition**: appreciation or acclaim for an achievement, service, or ability. (किसी उपलब्धि, सेवा या क्षमता के लिए प्रशंसा या प्रशंसा।) • **Prosperity**: the state of being successful and having a lot of money. (सफल होने और बहुत सारा पैसा होने की अवस्था या भाव।) • ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**prosperity**" is the synonym for the word "**opulence**". • **Example**: *Akbar's reign as a ruler was marked with **prosperity **__and harmony.* ​Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.** 36:T6dd, The correct answer is "**To withdraw from**"
